modelDescription: Shotguns provide a diversity of small- and medium-sized game hunting opportunities. That requires an equally diverse selection of shotshell loads. Fiocchi’s expansive line of Field Dynamics shotshells ensures you will find a load that is just right for every hunt. They are made to the same exacting standards and with the high-quality components typical of Fiocchi’s top-shelf ammunition.
